sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

As we have not received a response to our final offer, we must assume you do not accept it. We are therefore withdrawing our offer and closing this negotiation. We are withdrawing from this negotiation. 

We value the twelve years we have worked together and hope we can find common ground again in the future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We have already taken that notice period data into account.
We note your response, but we see that your proposed price has decreased from your previous offer, which we cannot accept.
We have already accommodated your requests for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms, and we expect a realistic step forward.
Please provide the data supporting your position, as our offer of €52.30 remains firm.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
We have already taken that notice period data into account.
We note your statement that this is your final position, but we cannot accept a price that decreases with every round.
We have already accommodated your requests for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms.
Therefore, €52.30 is our final offer for this package.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
